steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Order. Each backup job is placed by the age of its last good copy.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 backup is older than its target

findings.title: Last good copy older than its target
findings.fix: Run the job and check it completes

findings.title: Failed job with no ticket
findings.fix: Open a ticket for the failure

findings.title: Job with no record
findings.fix: Record the job in the backup register

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 2 medium).
[high] job-crm:12  Last good copy older than its target.
       Fix: Run the job and check it completes.
[medium] job-mail:19  Failed job with no ticket.
       Fix: Open a ticket for the failure.
[medium] job-config:26  Job with no record.
       Fix: Record the job in the backup register.
Not checked: Whether the backup restores.
pros: Flags a failed job with no ticket, a last good copy older than its target, and a job with no record.
cons: Not checked: Whether the backup restores.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-techops-backup-check skill on the records for this review.
